navtara.howBody: Use dasha, gochara and natal placement to confirm what will happen. Use Navtara to read the nature of the experience and your decision window (Vipat / Pratyari / Vadha call for extra caution). Gochara without a supporting dasha brings only energy, not events.

navtara.muhurtaLead: Check the day’s Moon nakshatra before booking a vehicle delivery, starting a renovation or signing an agreement. Avoid Vipat / Pratyari / Vadha days.

taramandal.intro: Taramandal is different from Navtara. Every nakshatra belongs to one or more constellation groups, and planets placed in a group take on that mandal’s cosmic role.
taramandal.unmapped: This star isn’t yet mapped to a complete Taramandal in the current teaching set.
taramandal.emptyChart: Under the taught memberships, no complete mandal currently holds the Moon, Lagna or a core planet in this chart.
taramandal.taughtLead: {count} taught mandals · each nakshatra belongs to a constellation group the way a member serves a king.
taramandal.notNavtaraBody: Navtara counts nine tara steps outward from the birth star. Taramandal works differently: fixed constellation groups that each hold nakshatras as members. When planets fall within a mandal, what they signify takes on that group’s cosmic energy — which can produce patterns sometimes mistaken for stelliums.
taramandal.coverageBody: The only remaining gaps are the upcoming Mrityu Karma and Gyan mandals (their kings are recorded; the full groups are pending). Partial members in other mandals still count.
